cards.example_es: Siempre hago la maleta la noche antes.
cards.example_en: I always pack the night before.

cards.example_es: Hice una reserva para dos noches.
cards.example_en: I made a booking for two nights.

cards.example_es: Ya he sacado los billetes de tren.
cards.example_en: I've already bought the train tickets.

cards.example_es: Para ir a la India necesitas visado.
cards.example_en: You need a visa to go to India.

cards.example_es: Buscamos alojamiento cerca de la playa.
cards.example_en: We're looking for accommodation near the beach.

cards.example_es: Facturé la maleta y fui a la puerta de embarque.
cards.example_en: I checked my case and went to the gate.

cards.example_es: Contratamos un seguro de viaje por si acaso.
cards.example_en: We took out travel insurance just in case.

cards.example_es: Hicimos escala en Lisboa.
cards.example_en: We had a stopover in Lisbon.

cards.example_es: Perdimos el avión por un atasco.
cards.example_en: We missed the plane because of a traffic jam.

cards.example_es: Solo llevo equipaje de mano.
cards.example_en: I'm only taking hand luggage.

cards.example_es: El vuelo salió con dos horas de retraso.
cards.example_en: The flight left two hours late.

cards.example_es: Mis padres prefieren los viajes organizados.
cards.example_en: My parents prefer package tours.

cards.example_es: Estuvo en Milán en un viaje de negocios.
cards.example_en: He was in Milan on a business trip.

cards.example_es: Se fueron de luna de miel a Japón.
cards.example_en: They went to Japan on honeymoon.

cards.example_es: Nunca he hecho un crucero.
cards.example_en: I've never been on a cruise.

cards.example_es: El turismo rural ha crecido mucho.
cards.example_en: Rural tourism has grown a lot.

cards.example_es: Dormimos en un albergue del Camino.
cards.example_en: We slept in a hostel on the Camino.

cards.example_es: Alquilamos una casa rural en la sierra.
cards.example_en: We rented a cottage in the mountains.

cards.example_es: Resulta que el hotel no tenía nuestra reserva.
cards.example_en: It turned out the hotel didn't have our booking.

cards.example_es: Total, que dormimos en el coche.
cards.example_en: So in the end we slept in the car.

cards.example_es: Al día siguiente fuimos a la playa.
cards.example_en: The next day we went to the beach.

cards.example_es: Aquella noche no dormimos nada.
cards.example_en: We didn't sleep at all that night.

cards.example_es: —Nos quedamos encerrados en el ascensor. —¡No me digas!
cards.example_en: —We got stuck in the lift. —No way!

cards.example_es: —Al final encontramos las llaves. —¡Menos mal!
cards.example_en: —In the end we found the keys. —Thank goodness!

cards.example_es: —Llovió toda la semana. —¡Qué mala suerte!
cards.example_en: —It rained all week. —What bad luck!

cards.example_es: ¿Qué te pasó en el aeropuerto?
cards.example_en: What happened to you at the airport?

cards.example_es: No había plazas, así que fuimos en tren.
cards.example_en: There were no seats, so we went by train.

cards.example_es: —Han cancelado el vuelo. —O sea que no volvéis hoy.
cards.example_en: —They've cancelled the flight. —So you're not coming back today.

cards.example_es: Nos perdimos en el casco antiguo.
cards.example_en: We got lost in the old town.

cards.example_es: El guía nos explicó la historia del barrio.
cards.example_en: The guide explained the history of the neighbourhood.
